chunks.text:
[Bridge - storyteller alone]
{spoken, low} I know how every story ends. I've read them all:
the fox, the crow, the boy who cried, the one who flew too near the sun.
I know the moral before the page. That's the job:
you stand in the dark, and you know.
{a breath} ...I didn't know this one.
{sung, one long held note with vibrato} So I'm putting down the book.
{silence, one clack} Mukashi mukashi was a long time ago.
This is now. Sorekara?
positive_styles: low contralto female storyteller, dry, close-mic, straight tone, half-spoken sliding into song
straight tone throughout, then ONE long held note with vibrato
builds at the very end into a key change
FEMALE VOCALIST SINGS EVERY LINE, vocals clearly audible from the first bar

chunks.text:
[Outro]
{spoken, dry} ...tsuzuku.
{bright, spoken} See you next prompt!
positive_styles: final chord a bare open fifth on D with no third
a music box plays four notes
FEMALE VOCALIST SINGS EVERY LINE, vocals clearly audible from the first bar
